mapper.select:
select av.achievement_id as "sourceAchievementId", dcc.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", dcc.area_code as "areaCode", dcc.department_organization_code as "organizationCode", av.handler_user_id as "targetUserId", av.next_status as "sourceStatus", case when em.evaluation_material_id is not null then 'GENERATED' when av.next_status in ('CERTIFIED','EVALUATION_CONFIRMED') then 'READY' else 'EXCLUDED' end as "generationStatus", em.generation_batch_id as "generationBatchId", coalesce(em.created_at, av.processed_at) as "lastProcessedAt", case when av.next_status not in ('CERTIFIED','EVALUATION_CONFIRMED') then '인증 이상 상태가 아닌 원천 실적 제외' else null end as "excludedReason" from achievement_verifications av join department_chair_confirmations dcc on dcc.achievement_id = av.achievement_id left join evaluation_materials em on em.source_achievement_id = av.achievement_id and em.evaluation_year = dcc.evaluation_year and em.area_code = dcc.area_code and em.target_user_id = av.handler_user_id and em.deleted_yn = 'N'
order by coalesce(em.created_at, av.processed_at) desc, av.achievement_id desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}

select count(*) from achievement_verifications av join department_chair_confirmations dcc on dcc.achievement_id = av.achievement_id left join evaluation_materials em on em.source_achievement_id = av.achievement_id and em.evaluation_year = dcc.evaluation_year and em.area_code = dcc.area_code and em.target_user_id = av.handler_user_id and em.deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_batch_jobs (batch_job_id, batch_type, evaluation_year, area_code, organization_code, target_user_id, target_condition_json, total_count, success_count, failure_count, excluded_count, job_status, requested_by, request_id, created_by, updated_by) values (#{batchJobId}, 'GENERATION', #{request.evaluationYear}, #{request.areaCode}, nullif(#{request.organizationCode}, ''), #{request.targetUserId}, jsonb_build_object('evaluationYear', #{request.evaluationYear}, 'areaCode', #{request.areaCode}, 'organizationCode', nullif(#{request.organizationCode}, ''), 'targetUserId', #{request.targetUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, 'reason', #{request.reason}), #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{failureCount}, #{excludedCount}, 'COMPLETED', #{requestedBy}, #{requestId}, #{requestedBy}, #{requestedBy})

insert into evaluation_batch_job_items (batch_job_id, target_ref, result_status, error_code, error_message, excluded_reason, request_id, created_by, updated_by) values (#{batchJobId}, #{targetRef}, #{resultStatus}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{excludedReason}, #{requestId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: update evaluation_batch_jobs set success_count = #{successCount}, failure_count = #{failureCount}, excluded_count = #{excludedCount}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() where batch_job_id = #{batchJobId}
